 **Aion** supplies the protected programme's psychological reading of historical time: **Christ/Antichrist, Pisces, Gnostic and alchemical images of the Self**, and a movement of opposition and reversal within the Christian aeon. The inherited branch also retains Jung's conjunction of **sixteenth-century schism**, an outward or horizontal movement of consciousness, discovery and the conquest of nature, and alchemy's relation to scientific modernity. These remain Jungian historical-psychological constructions as received in the programme. They are not supplied as independent causal history of the Reformation or scientific institutions.
 
-The [canonical Aion house](../../../sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md) selects the **1978 corrected printing of the second edition**, but contains no acquired passage cards. Its metadata and prose also disagree about the discoverability of an external local copy. This companion therefore adds no page or paragraph number and no purported Jung quotation. +The [canonical Aion house](../../../sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md#passages) retains the selected **1978 corrected hardcover printing** and now records sixteen contextual paraphrase locations from the actual **1979 paperback reading carrier**. AION-P06 identifies VII, §§150–154, pp. 95–97 for the sixteenth-century schism and outward turn; AION-P12 identifies XII, §§267–271, pp. 173–174 for alchemy, science and the later faith/knowledge division. These consulted locations make this branch recoverable. Collation against the selected printing and verification of any proposed quotation remain Open; neither is claimed by this passage map. Jung’s historical-psychological interpretation remains distinct from independent causal history.
 
 The psychic operation remains developed: an image can organise what a historical community fears, expects or recognises in an event. A polarity can give a sequence affective direction; a later account can receive an earlier figure under changed conditions. That reading needs the determinate history through which the image acted. It cannot establish a marriage, a treaty, a translation or an institutional decision by symbolic resemblance. Historical Logos and archetypal Logos thus return to one another through different questions. Shared Neumann structuration does not turn European religious time into the developmental measure of the other branches. E2 receives recollection that resituates an account; the mythic whole retains the complete symbolic telling and its separate source debt.
